verdict.rationale: RingCentral documents built-in AI features you can hand work to: an AI Receptionist that answers and routes calls, and an 'Agentic Voice AI platform' to automate and assist customer interactions. That is real but narrow delegation, limited to call handling, and the evidence is one-line marketing copy. The MCP and 'connect to ChatGPT & Claude' items describe external LLMs, not a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-app assistant users can assign arbitrary tasks to, documentation of how delegation works and its scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
